LESSON: WRITING 14.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.4: Writing 14.4.1 Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 14.4.1 Guided Writing, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we order words or phrases to make correct sentences? 2. How can we identify correctly constructed sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. talk about the correct way of ordering the jumbled words.

2. reorganise the jumbled words to form simple sentences paying attention to punctuation (4-6 sentences).

3. work to assess each other’s simple sentences.

4. take turns in playing games with jumbled words to form meaningful sentences with peers. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. talk about the correct way of ordering the jumbled words.
2. reorganise the jumbled words to form simple sentences paying attention to punctuation (4-6 sentences).
3. work to assess each other’s simple sentences.
4. take turns in playing games with jumbled words to form meaningful sentences with peers. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 14.4.1 Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn-as learner writes own sentences

Values:
Responsibility as learner ensures he/she writes correct sentences

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental and social issues (environmental education) –as learner writes related to the environment.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Writing skills are essential in all learning areas.
